mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_channel_station_feedback WHERE source_id>#{afterSourceId} AND ingest_status IN ('REVIEW_NEEDED','FAILED_FINAL') AND (lease_expires_at IS NULL OR lease_expires_at<NOW(3)) ORDER BY source_id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE t_channel_station_feedback SET product_id=CASE WHEN product_id='UNKNOWN' THEN #{productId} ELSE product_id END, source_product_name=COALESCE(NULLIF(source_product_name,''),#{sourceProductName}), source_app_id=COALESCE(NULLIF(source_app_id,''),#{sourceAppId}), source_app_name=COALESCE(NULLIF(source_app_name,''),#{sourceAppName}), source_user_id=COALESCE(NULLIF(source_user_id,''),#{sourceUserId}),updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE source_id=#{sourceId} AND (lease_expires_at IS NULL OR lease_expires_at<NOW(3))

UPDATE t_channel_station_feedback SET contact_status=#{contactStatus},pending_photo_urls=#{pendingPhotoUrls}, ingest_status=#{ingestStatus},processing_stage=#{processingStage},next_retry_at=#{nextRetryAt},retry_count=0, lease_owner=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL,last_error_code=#{lastErrorCode},last_error_summary=#{lastErrorSummary}, processed_at=#{processedAt},updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE source_id=#{sourceId} AND ingest_status IN ('COMPLETED','REVIEW_NEEDED','FAILED_FINAL') AND (lease_expires_at IS NULL OR lease_expires_at<NOW(3))
